annotations.title: Check up to 10 links in one call: a link verdict (ok, broken, moved, unknown) per URL, optional expected_text

description: Checks up to 10 URLs: ok, broken, moved or unknown for each, with final URL and title. US$0.005 per call; POST URLs. 10 free calls a day per IP, resetting at midnight UTC. Costs US$0.005 per call in USDC via x402 (Base), charged when the call answers below 400 (a no-match or not-found result is charged too); a bad request is refused unpaid. Pay by putting an x402 payment payload in _meta["x402/payment"]. Without one it uses the free trial (10 calls a day per address), then returns the payment requirements. Docs: https://vehcdj664efetfrsolne5umanq.srv.us/docs/check-links

urls.description: 1 to 10 items, each an http(s) URL string or { "url", "expected_text" }. Dead domains are reported as results; if none resolves, 422 and no charge.

expected_text.description: Optional text the page should contain (fuzzy match). Reported as expected_text.match; it does not change the link verdict.

name: attestpage_check_links

results.description: One entry per URL, each with a link verdict (ok, broken, moved or unknown; per URL, signed into the receipt), server_ip, tls and headers (network evidence also signed into the receipt; null on an edge server). off_site_error: true when the URL redirected to another site that answers 4xx/5xx. expected_text: null unless the item sent expected_text and the page was read as real; then { match: exact, fuzzy or none, score, start, end, context, quote_sha256, evidence }, reported only (the verdict does not change).

title: Check up to 10 links in one call: a link verdict (ok, broken, moved, unknown) per URL, optional expected_text
